markers.title: Ukraine–Russia War
markers.why: Sets European security posture, NATO aid levels, and energy/grain risk pricing.
markers.watch: Deep strikes, front advances/retreats, NATO air-defense stocks.

markers.title: Iran / Hormuz Theater
markers.detail: Direct and proxy exchanges near a global oil artery.
markers.why: Hormuz handles a large share of seaborne oil; kinetic risk moves markets fast.
markers.watch: Tanker incidents, claimed strikes, Strait transit disruptions.

markers.title: Taiwan Strait Pressure
markers.detail: Sustained PLA air and naval activity around Taiwan.
markers.why: Critical Indo-Pacific deterrence node and semiconductor supply-chain risk.
markers.watch: Sortie counts, naval exercises, US/partner transit operations.

markers.title: Israel–Iran Axis Front
markers.detail: Multi-front residual risk across Israel, Lebanon, Iran, and proxies.
markers.why: Can re-open wider Middle East escalation with energy and nuclear dossiers.
markers.watch: Northern front fire, deep-strike claims, ceasefire durability.

markers.title: Sudan Civil War
markers.detail: SAF vs RSF with severe civilian impact.
markers.why: One of the world’s worst active humanitarian crises.
markers.watch: Control of cities, famine indicators, humanitarian access.

markers.title: Yemen / Red Sea
markers.detail: Residual interdiction risk on Red Sea shipping lanes.
markers.why: Affects Bab el-Mandeb traffic, insurance rates, Asia–Europe routing.
markers.watch: Ship attacks, insurance war-risk premiums, Suez diversion rates.

markers.title: Strait of Hormuz
markers.detail: Primary oil chokepoint linking Gulf producers to global markets.
markers.why: Temporary disruption can spike crude prices worldwide.
markers.watch: Transit volume, naval escorts, oil futures reaction.

markers.title: Bab el-Mandeb / Red Sea
markers.why: Rerouting around Africa raises time/cost for Europe–Asia trade.
markers.watch: Attack reports, carrier diversions, war-risk insurance.

markers.title: US Markets / New York
markers.detail: Major equity, rates, and risk-sentiment node.
markers.why: Shows how investors price conflict, energy, and policy risk.
markers.watch: VIX/equity swings after kinetic headlines, USD safe-haven moves.

markers.title: London / Europe Energy & Defense
markers.detail: European exposure to Middle East energy and elevated defense spending.
markers.why: Gas, power prices, and defense budgets react to Ukraine and Hormuz risk.
markers.watch: TTF gas prices, defense stock moves, UK/EU policy statements.
